author: jochembrouwer
content: We now shape TCREATE as CREATE2. I could imagine that executing different code from same account could make sense. (so CREATE usage instead of CREATE2 usage). I guess this is still possible by having initcode fetch runtime code from a helper contract 🤔  So we would for instance use TSTORE to save runtime bytecode, or point to a different TCREATE contract
